skill.name: content-marketer
skill.description: Content marketing strategist for AI-assisted content planning, SEO optimization, omnichannel distribution, email nurture, social campaigns, and performance reporting.
skill.summary: Builds content strategies, campaign plans, and channel-specific marketing workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Marketing teams need consistent content plans across search, email, and social channels. This skill turns goals, audiences, and offers into practical content strategies.
actual_capabilities: Plan content strategies around audiences, KPIs, content pillars, and distribution channels.
Create SEO-focused blog, product, social, email, and multimedia content plans.
Suggest distribution across social, email, paid promotion, partnerships, video, and podcasts.
Define performance tracking, A/B testing, attribution, and optimization workflows.
Build editorial calendars, launch campaigns, and content repurposing plans.
limitations: Does not run external marketing tools or publish content by itself.
Requires audience, offer, channel, and brand context for specific recommendations.
Cannot guarantee search rankings, ad results, or conversion outcomes.
Does not replace legal review for regulated marketing claims or privacy compliance.

use_cases.title: SaaS Launch Planning
use_cases.description: Create a content plan for product education, lead capture, sales enablement, and post-launch optimization.

use_cases.title: E-Commerce Campaigns
use_cases.description: Plan product pages, email flows, social posts, seasonal campaigns, and review-driven conversion content.

use_cases.title: Editorial SEO Growth
use_cases.description: Build topic clusters, keyword-led calendars, featured snippet targets, and refresh plans for existing content.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-week content plan for [business] targeting [audience]. Include goals, channels, content themes, and success metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a new campaign with limited existing assets.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Existing Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content brief or draft for SEO, audience fit, conversion intent, and channel reuse. Suggest prioritized improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when improving a draft, landing page, article, or campaign asset.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Launch Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a launch content campaign for [product] with audience segments, messages, calendar, channels, email sequence, and measurement plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing a product, feature, or service launch.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Omnichannel Growth System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 90-day omnichannel content system for [goal]. Include content pillars, workflows, repurposing, testing, attribution, and reporting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced strategy across teams, channels, and performance goals.

output_examples.input: A SaaS launch for a project management tool targeting operations leaders.
output: A launch narrative focused on visibility, handoffs, and measurable team execution.
A six-week calendar covering educational posts, comparison content, customer proof, and email nurture.
A reporting plan with demo requests, qualified leads, activation rate, and content-assisted pipeline.

output_examples.input: An e-commerce brand needs holiday content for a skincare product line.
output: Gift-focused product page angles, short-form video themes, and review-led social proof assets.
Email sequence ideas for early access, cart recovery, shipping deadlines, and post-purchase education.
Channel-specific edits for Instagram, TikTok, search landing pages, and newsletters.

output_examples.input: A content team wants to refresh old blog posts for search growth.
output: A prioritization method based on traffic loss, ranking distance, conversion value, and content age.
Refresh actions for title tags, internal links, topical depth, examples, and calls to action.
A measurement plan comparing impressions, clicks, rankings, assisted conversions, and engagement.

best_practices: Provide audience, offer, channel, timeline, and conversion goal before asking for a campaign plan.
Ask for a measurement plan so each content recommendation connects to a KPI.
Review generated claims for brand accuracy, compliance, and factual support before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a complete strategy without naming the target audience or offer.
Do not publish AI-generated claims about competitors, products, or results without verification.
Do not copy one message across every channel without platform-specific edits.

faq.question: Can this skill write finished marketing content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft copy, outlines, calendars, and campaign assets, but final review should match brand and compliance requirements.

faq.question: Does it connect to marketing platforms?
faq.answer: No. It gives strategy and workflow guidance, but it does not directly operate Buffer, GA4, ad platforms, or email tools.

faq.question: Can it help with SEO planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan keyword themes, topic clusters, content gaps, refresh actions, and search-focused content briefs.

faq.question: Can it plan paid content promotion?
faq.answer: Yes. It can include paid distribution ideas, but it does not manage spend, bidding, targeting, or platform settings.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: It can support compliant planning, but legal, medical, financial, or privacy-sensitive claims need qualified human review.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide audience details, product value, brand voice, channels, timeline, budget range, existing assets, and success metrics.
